decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - Before the works hereby approved are commenced, a detailed scheme showing the means to be taken to reduce the effect on ground loading (including water table implications), contiguity, and structural design of the single storey extension in relation to the old wall fronting Thames Road, together with the means of protecting the wall during construction works, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall be completed in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 3 - Before the works hereby approved are commenced, a detailed scheme showing:
(a) the proposed edge flashing, its connection with the old wall and means of rainwater protection/disposal.
(b) other weathering/connection details of the proposed building with the wall.
(c) colour/finishes of cladding, roof and flashings, rainwater goods.
(d) boundary treatments
(e) materials generally, including pointing and joinery details

shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be completed in accordance with the approved details.
description: Conversion of existing garages / studio into a two bedroom self contained dwellinghouse LISTED BUILDING CONSENT
